title: Linear
description: Engineered calm on near-black: a #08090a page, panels one step lighter, white-8% hairlines, four greys of cool text, a pale grey pill button and two late colour accents (a pale blue-to-lavender glow and an electric lime). One neo-grotesk at weight 510 for headings with tight tracking, and a slabbed mono for captions.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling in the same spirit (soft white page, dark pill button)
Inter Variable is the original's own face; IBM Plex Mono stands in for Berkeley Mono (closed)
--page-width is 80rem (1280px content); --page-gutter 24px on phones, 80px-ish at 1440 comes from centring
chart-1 is the coral red of a 'newest' dot; chart-5 the lavender end of the glow card gradient
